newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Cuba's Castro gives crocodiles to Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Cuba's Castro gives crocodiles to Vietnam.

text.p: Socialist solidarity between Vietnam and Cuba appeared alive and snapping on Wednesday as Hanoi took delivery of 150 infant crocodiles from Havana.
Agriculture Ministry officials told Reuters all 150 had arrived in Vietnam in good health. They were sent as an official gift, and would be used for breeding purposes.
"We've got to keep them here for a while to see that they adapt to Vietnamese living conditions," one official said by phone.
Cuba and Vietnam are two of the world's remaining communist states and continue to maintain close relations.
